item.description:
AgentsEye 0.17.25 makes usage and billing language clearer and fixes interrupted supporter checkout recovery.
- Replace internal feature names with direct labels such as Usage history, Prompt history, Provider routes, and Outcome ratings. - Label token-based dollar amounts as estimated API cost, separate from subscription billing. - Explain supported provider limits and local pace estimates more precisely across the app and website. - Resume an interrupted Stripe checkout only when its monthly or annual plan matches the plan selected in AgentsEye. A mismatch now names the checkout already in progress and tells you how to resume it. - Keep checkout recovery idempotent so a retry cannot create a second payable session for the same attempt.

AgentsEye 0.17.24 brings quotas to the macOS desktop and adds an optional way to support the app. This build also updates Macs that previously ran the signed widget preview.
- Add small and medium widgets for Codex or up to four enabled providers. They follow the dashboard's quota window, remaining/used mode, provider filter, sort order, and appearance. - Keep widget sharing local and minimal. The extension receives quota percentages, reset times, pace, and availability, without prompts, sessions, credentials, account IDs, or network access. - Add **Copy quota summary** for a private Markdown snapshot that is easy to paste into planning notes or a conversation. - Add an optional Founding Supporter subscription at USD 6/month or USD 48/year. Every beta feature remains free; Stripe handles payment details in the browser. - Make supporter checkout, restore, cancellation, refunds, disputes, retries, and duplicate webhooks fail safely without creating a second subscription or exposing Stripe customer data to the app. - Replace in-place local installs with a staged, verified app replacement so removed widget or framework files cannot survive an update.
